Hi — I need your help processing the raw notes from our Q3 Feature Scoping call that happened yesterday. The notes are saved somewhere in the meetings folder. 

I need two things out of this:

1. A clean task tracking spreadsheet (call it `q3_scoping_tasks.csv`) so we can drop it straight into our project tracker. Make sure ownership is clear — if nobody was named for a task, flag it properly. Don't add any deadlines we didn't actually discuss.

2. A shareable meeting recap document (call it `meeting_recap.md`) that our product and engineering leads can quickly read. It should cover everything important: what we decided, what's blocked, who needs to do what, and any questions we still haven't answered.

Please use the tools and templates we have in the repo — I know there are some scripts and a template file in there somewhere that are supposed to help with exactly this.
